title: Step 2b: Statistical Significance - P-values & Stars in Regression

cues.en: -: So that's great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: That's the first thing to notice.
cues.zh: 這是第一個要注意的地方。

cues.en: And then what I was telling you is that for each of the coefficient, we have different information.
cues.zh: 接著，每個係數都會有不同資訊。

cues.en: We have actually the coefficient in the linear regression equation then we have the standard error, then the T value, then the P value here, and then the significance level.
cues.zh: 包含迴歸方程式中的係數、標準誤、t 值、p 值，以及顯著性標記。

cues.en: So the most important info by looking at this are the last two columns, the P value and the significance level.
cues.zh: 其中最值得留意的，是最後兩欄，p 值與顯著性。

cues.en: Because these columns tell us about the statistical significance of the independent variable onto the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 因為它們反映自變數對依變數的統計顯著性。

cues.en: That means it tells us if each of the independent variable has a significant impact on the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 也就是每個自變數是否有顯著影響。

cues.en: Okay, so let me first explain what the P value is.
cues.zh: 先說明 p 值。

cues.en: The most important thing to understand is that the lower the P value is, then the most statistically significant your independent variable is going to be.
cues.zh: 重點是，p 值愈小，自變數的統計顯著性愈高。

cues.en: That means that the lower the P value is, the more impact or effect your independent variable is going to have on the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 也就是講者所說，p 值愈小，自變數對依變數的影響愈明顯。

cues.en: And generally, a good threshold to use is the five percent threshold.
cues.zh: 一般常用 5% 當門檻。

cues.en: That means that if your P value is lower than five percent, then that means that your independent variable would be highly statistically significant, and the more it is above five percent,
cues.zh: p 值低於 5%，代表自變數達統計顯著；高於 5% 愈多，

cues.en: the less it will be statistically significant.
cues.zh: 顯著性就愈低。

cues.en: So that's how you must interpret the P value.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡的解讀方式。

cues.en: And then we have this last column which is just a faster way of interpreting the coefficients because as you can see, we have this line here that explains us about the stars,
cues.zh: 最後一欄，是更快解讀係數的方法，這行說明了星號的意義。

cues.en: and basically what the stars means is that when the P value is between zero and 0.01 percent, then there's gonna be three stars
cues.zh: 基本上，當 p 值介於 0 與 0.01% 之間，會有三顆星，

cues.en: which means a highly statistical significance of your independent variable.
cues.zh: 代表自變數高度統計顯著。

cues.en: If the P value is between 0.1 percent and 1 percent, then it's a quite high level of statistical significance.
cues.zh: p 值在 0.1% 到 1% 之間，顯著性也相當高。

cues.en: Then if your P value is between 1 percent and 5 percent, then the independent variable is still statistically significant, but will have a less strong effect
cues.zh: p 值在 1% 到 5% 之間，仍具統計顯著性，但影響強度

cues.en: than the first categories.
cues.zh: 比前面幾類低。

cues.en: And then if your P value is between 5 percent and 10 percent, it's borderline.
cues.zh: p 值在 5% 到 10% 之間，則屬邊緣。

cues.en: The independent variable might have a certain level of statistical significance, but not that much.
cues.zh: 可能有一定顯著性，但不高。

cues.en: Anyway, a lot less than those independent variables that have three stars or two stars.
cues.zh: 總之，比三顆或兩顆星的變數低得多。

cues.en: And then if your P value is between 10 percent and one, then there is absolutely no statistical significance.
cues.zh: p 值在 10% 到 1，也就是 100% 之間，就沒有統計顯著性。

cues.en: That means that your independent variable won't have any effect on the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 講者把它解讀為對依變數沒有影響。

cues.en: So that's very interesting because when we look at our independent variables here, we notice that only one variable has a high statistical significance
cues.zh: 很有趣，因為看這些自變數，發現只有一個

cues.en: onto the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 對依變數高度統計顯著。

cues.en: It's the R.D.Spend.
cues.zh: 就是 R.D.Spend。

cues.en: So it looks like the profit is mainly governed by the R.D.Spend.
cues.zh: 看起來 Profit 主要受研發支出影響。

cues.en: That means that it's the R.D.Spend that has the only strong effect on the profit.
cues.zh: 也就是只有研發支出具有強烈效果。

cues.en: So that's very important information for our investors because they now know that they shouldn't only be looking at the profit itself by, you know, just looking at the maximum profit to decide where to invest.
cues.zh: 這對投資人很重要，因為不能只看利潤最大，就決定投資。

cues.en: But also it should be looking at the R.D.Spend variable.
cues.zh: 也應留意 R.D.Spend。

cues.en: It should be looking at the amount spent in R&D to add another criterion in their investment decisions.
cues.zh: 把研發支出金額，當成投資決策的另一項條件。

cues.en: So that's some very good info.
cues.zh: 這是很有用的資訊。

cues.en: And basically what it means, what all this means is that among all the independent variables here, the only predictor, the only strong predictor of the profit is the R.D.Spend.
cues.zh: 基本上，在這些自變數中，唯一強力預測 Profit 的，是 R.D.Spend。

cues.en: The rest is absolutely, like, unuseful.
cues.zh: 其餘看起來沒有明顯幫助。

cues.en: So actually what this means is that we could, we could rewrite this multiple linear regression equation and turn it into a simple linear regression,
cues.zh: 因此，可能可以改寫多元線性迴歸，變成簡單線性迴歸。

cues.en: because since the only independent variable that has an effect on the profit dependent variable is the R.D.Spend,
cues.zh: 既然只有 R.D.Spend 對依變數 Profit 有明顯效果，

cues.en: then the formula could be profit equals R.D.Spend.
cues.zh: 公式就可以寫成 Profit ~ R.D.Spend。

cues.en: And that would be okay, that would actually give us the same prediction.
cues.zh: 講者認為，這樣也能得到相近的預測。

cues.en: Okay, so you learned a lot of stuff in this tutorial, but that's very important things to know in linear regression, so congratulations.
cues.zh: 這堂學了很多，都是線性迴歸裡重要的知識，恭喜。

cues.en: We only have one tutorial left where we'll be predicting the test set results, so I look forward to seeing you there and until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 只剩下一堂預測測試集結果，期待到時見，在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
